tools.name: Microsoft Playwright MCP
tools.contents: Local MCP server for browser interaction: navigation, accessibility snapshots, typing/form fill, file upload, screenshots. It is not a purpose-built job search service.
tools.setup: Node.js 18+ and an MCP client; official npx @playwright/mcp@latest configuration; our guide adds Chrome and isolated context.
tools.needs: Installed Chrome, runtime/network and client access; Claude account/plan limits separate. No Playwright API key for local server.

tools.name: Claude Desktop
tools.license: Proprietary service; do not describe as free/open source
tools.contents: Model client that can use configured local MCP tools.
tools.setup: Local-server config then restart; some organizations restrict tools.
tools.needs: Authorized Claude access and available usage; no purchase performed.

safe_rule_one_line: Use permitted sites, review every answer, and stop before Submit.
reference_claim_issues: Job guarantee is unsupported. Replace with preparation assistance.
Free applies to the open-source browser package; do not call Claude or the entire workflow free.
One paste omits runtime/client setup and permissions.
A recent listing does not guarantee a stronger application or less competition.
Exactly ten matches and displayed match percentages are illustrative; request up to ten with evidence.
Every form is not supported universally; site access and compatibility vary.
LinkedIn bot prohibition does not establish a lunchtime-ban prediction.
Ten applications a day is not a verified safe quota for company sites.
Stopping before Submit does not prevent data transmission from earlier form entry/upload.
Generic company boards and the animated sheet are not evidence of actual results.

sources.claim: Official Microsoft Playwright MCP supports accessibility snapshots, navigation, form filling and uploads; Node.js 18+ and an MCP client are requirements; Apache-2.0 licence.
Claude Desktop supports local MCP servers; setup depends on client configuration and organizational controls.
Desktop manual configuration uses Developer/Edit Config and requires a full restart.
Claude access, plans and usage limits are separate from the Playwright open-source package.
LinkedIn User Agreement prohibits unauthorized bots and scraping; no timing for a ban or universal safe daily quota is stated.
